title: 💡 Tips to get your creative juices flowing
html:
Creativity - the ability to create. How much time do you put into being creative? A lot, or you're so busy (get off your screen) not much?

Creativity and play will enhance your learning and your capabilities as a champion in the game of life. Don’t think playing is only for children, adults can benefit from just having a laugh, dancing around with kids/pets and generally acting like a BIG kid.

I have put together some tips that might help get your CREATIVE juices flowing.

  • Exercise - exercise releases endorphins and increases nerve connections to the brain

  • Listen to music - music from Mozart or Bach (Baroque) is especially good

  • Eat foods high in Vitamin B and get your minerals

  • Have a brains trust - surround yourself with enthusiastic, inspiring people, read

  • Carry a notebook - write your ideas and thoughts down when you have them

  • Make time to daydream and relax

  • Listen to your gut - it is usually right

  • Ask better questions - if you don’t understand....ask!

  • Have clear goals

  • Be spontaneous

  • Listen - you have FOUR ways to listen, eyes and ears

Those are just some of what might help you to become more creative. There are lots more and I challenge you to get creative and send some of your creative thoughts to me. They might end up in the next Monday Motivator.

Have a terrifically creative week.

Glenn “Picasso” Edley
